whenToUse: Lists with a known total, such as products or reviews.
There's a footer or other content below the list.
You let people decide themselves whether to see more.
whenNotToUse: A feed browsed endlessly (use infinite scroll).
People need to jump to a specific page (use pagination).
There are only a few items (show them all).

alternatives.name: Pagination
alternatives.reason: Remembering a position by page number.

accessibility: Put the shown and total counts in the button name, such as "(6/24)".
After loading, move focus to the first new item so keyboard users don't start over from the top.
While loading, the button changes to "Loading" and turns off.
Remove the button once everything is shown.
